name: rendobar
description: Transform the media you have and generate the media you do not, on files from your own disk.
long_description:
Transform the media you have and generate the media you do not. This bundle is the local server, so an agent can take a file straight off your machine, run the job on Rendobar's infrastructure, and hand back a hosted URL without you touching a browser or installing a codec.

TRANSFORM WHAT YOU HAVE. Run any FFmpeg command against video, audio or images the way you would write it locally: transcode, trim, mux, filter, concat, whatever the flags allow. Inspect a file and get back a normalized summary plus the full ffprobe report. Compose video from a declarative JSON timeline with multi-track layering, transitions, text and per-clip effects. Compress to a target size or quality, where the encoder searches candidate encodes across AV1, HEVC, H.264, VP9, AVIF, WebP, Opus and more, then returns the smallest file that clears the bar. Burn in subtitles from an SRT, VTT or ASS file, or let it transcribe when none is given.

GENERATE WHAT YOU DO NOT. Create an image from a text prompt on hosted open-weight diffusion models, by quality tier or a pinned model id. Edit up to four reference images from a written instruction, no masks and no coordinates. Upscale on a one-step diffusion restoration model that reconstructs detail rather than only sharpening. The same model-backed layer drives the transcription and keyword highlighting behind animated captions, so this is not an image-only capability.

The job list grows over time, so this description names families rather than types. Call `list_job_types` for the current set, read live from the registry on every call. It is the only current answer to "can Rendobar do this".

The server starts without an API key so its tools can be listed, and `list_job_types` answers without one too, so you can see what Rendobar covers before deciding. Every other tool needs a key, which you can set below or write once with `rb login` from the Rendobar CLI.

api_key.title: Rendobar API key
api_key.description: Starts with rb_. Get one at https://app.rendobar.com under Settings, API Keys. Optional here: the server also reads RENDOBAR_API_KEY or the credentials file written by `rb login`.
